details: Two skills: german-sentence-coach, german-word-forms. Prompts v1-v3 failed on genders, verb forms and fixed phrases (see MEMORY.md).

Merged into one skill (german-teacher) so memory is shared. On-device memory: saved words with spaced review, verified corrections that override the tables, learner mistakes. Export loop to evolution/. Fixed: main clause with zu + infinitive was labelled an infinitive clause.

Answers in simple German by default (settings: en/de, remembered). Answer format appended to every analyze/word result. 80 checked phrase examples; 3 examples per word, the learner's book sentence first. Fixed: clause with its own finite verb before zu+infinitive is a main clause.
